Consumed by: server/server/src/studio_live_hashes.rs's own #[cfg(test)] mod tests (Rust — inline vector tests reusing the real WorkUnitPayloadRaw deserializer and is_terminal_status/TERMINAL_STATUSES logic directly, no external tests/ crate or pub test-only surface; mirrors the blob_layout_vectors_match_s3_key_derivation precedent in server/s3-blobs/src/lib.rs) and nodalmerge-studio/tests/NodalMerge.Studio.Contracts.Tests/WorkUnitStatusVectorTests.cs (.NET, against nodalmerge-studio/src/NodalMerge.Studio.Contracts/Domain/WorkUnit.cs's WorkUnitStatus enum and WorkUnit record, serialized with bare JsonSerializer.Serialize(entity) as IStudioNodeStore's real write path does — no naming policy, no JsonStringEnumConverter). If you reorder/rename/insert a WorkUnitStatus value, this file and BOTH harnesses must move together: a silent drift here means nodalmerge's GC coordinator (server/server/src/studio_live_hashes.rs) misclassifies live work-unit-seeded snapshots as garbage and deletes them in production, instead of failing a test.
terminal_status_names_comment: Per studio_live_hashes.rs's STATUS_COMPLETED/STATUS_FAILED/STATUS_MERGED consts and its doc comment: Cancelled/DeadLettered have live revival edges (WorkUnitTransitions.CanTransition) and are deliberately NOT terminal here, unlike a narrower cache-eviction terminal set elsewhere in studio. This list is the GC-relevant terminal set only.

work_unit_envelope_vectors.description: the smallest real envelope the Rust classifier receives for a fresh work unit: optional fields absent (null), non-terminal status
queue-driven pipeline status (Phase 4 slice 11a) with RepositoryId populated, no Metadata
a terminal status (protects the retention classifier's Pinned/Active/Intermediate rules) with a populated Metadata map

regression pin for the deliberately-non-terminal DeadLettered case (studio_live_hashes.rs doc comment): despite sounding like an end state, DeadLettered has a live revival edge back to Retrying/Proposed/Merged/Queued/Executing, so the GC classifier must NOT treat it as terminal

delegate_room_id_placeholder.$comment: Slot only, per slice 0.4's Note — the VALUE is deliberately undecided pending slice 7.4 (server/server/src/blob_http.rs:73 sends room="_global" into the shared delegate presign protocol v1; the .NET host sends room="default", ns="blobs" for the same room-agnostic routes).
